project_type: VS Code extension (Zoo Code, a Roo Code fork) — pnpm monorepo: src/ extension host, packages/types shared types, webview-ui React webview
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Per-package exec: `pnpm --dir <pkg> exec <tool>`. No branch switch — all work on the currently-checked-out branch feat/omniroute-tier-dropdown-feat005.
test_framework: Vitest in src/, packages/types, and webview-ui (run from each package dir). webview-ui also has a Playwright visual gallery, not needed here.
build_command: pnpm --dir src exec tsc --noEmit ; pnpm --dir packages/types exec tsc --noEmit ; pnpm --dir webview-ui exec tsc --noEmit
test_command: pnpm --dir src exec vitest run <path> ; pnpm --dir webview-ui exec vitest run <path>
verification_instructions: Per touched package: run tsc --noEmit for that package; run the narrowest relevant vitest suite(s); AFTER editing EACH src/ file run `pnpm --dir src exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 <relative-file>` and confirm the per-file suppression count in src/eslint-suppressions.json did NOT increase. Fix lint in new code rather than suppressing. Avoid `as any`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/eslint-suppressions.json tracks per-file suppressed-rule counts; counts must never increase. No code-generation step for these workstreams.
environment_constraints: Do NOT create .changeset files. Do NOT edit CHANGELOG.md or src/CHANGELOG.md. Task Lifecycle gate (pnpm lifecycle:model-check + pnpm test) does NOT apply — no workstream touches src/core/task-persistence/taskLifecycle.ts; confirm this holds. SettingsView inputs MUST bind to local cachedState, never live useExtensionState().
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md Persisted Setting Checklist for Workstream A's new setting; SettingsView cachedState buffer rule; per-file lint-suppression gate; no changeset/CHANGELOG edits.
key_patterns: enhancementApiConfigId is the reference implementation for condensingApiConfigId (schema -> ExtensionState -> ClineProvider round trip -> handler build from providerSettingsManager.getProfile + buildApiHandler). READER_MODES={project-reader} + reasoner-fallback ALREADY yields the intended tier mapping (project-reader->reader/9B field, project-research+code->reasoner/27B field) — B-i is labeling + test-hardening, NOT a logic change. OmniRoute profile has only TWO route fields: openAiOmniRouteReaderRouteId (LOW/9B) and openAiOmniRouteReasonerRouteId (HIGH/27B, shared by code + project-research).
relevant_files: src/core/context-management/index.ts (manageContext forwards apiHandler), src/core/condense/index.ts (summarizeConversation apiHandler param)
directory_structure: src/ = extension host (core/task, core/tools, core/webview, core/condense, core/context-management, core/config); packages/types/ = shared zod schemas + ExtensionState; webview-ui/ = React settings/chat UI + i18n locales. Each package has its own vitest config and tsconfig.
